parts.text: Doctor Jones is scheduling his time for Monday.
He is spending nine hours at the clinic where he works that day.
He has to do rounds to check on inpatients staying at the clinic, which takes twenty minutes per inpatient, and he has ten appointments, which take thirty minutes each.
If Doctor Jones has 1 hours left to update his records, how many inpatients does he have at the clinic?

parts.text: In a dwarven mining community, one dwarf can mine 12 pounds of ore per day with his bare hands.
However, if he uses an iron pickaxe, he can mine twice as much.
If he upgrades to a steel pickaxe, he can mine 50% more than with an iron pickaxe.

Now, imagine that there's a magical stone in the mine that glows brightly every 30 seconds but doesn't affect the mining speed.If there are 40 dwarves equipped with steel pickaxes in this mine, and they work for a month with 30 days, how many pounds of ore can they mine?

parts.text: Steve put together a puzzle that took 10 hours of hard work to complete.
Anna put together the same puzzle in 2 hours more than half Steve's time.
After completing the puzzle, Anna spent an additional 3 hours arranging the puzzle pieces back in their original boxes.
If Anna started arranging the pieces immediately after finishing the puzzle, how long did it take Anna in total to finish the difficult puzzle and arrange the pieces back in their boxes?

How many candies does Nick have?
